dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: It's a completely different feeling... fighting here.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: It's so different from dealing with nightmares. It almost feels like... dancing in a dream or enjoying some kind of impromptu performance.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I suppose this is as good a place as any to get some combat experience. Once we're done here, we should go for a soak in the hot springs.
